description: The secret masker of the approval card and the request (maskSecrets in lib/permissions.mjs): each rule of TOKEN_PATTERNS, the name of a secret (prefix, endings, quotes), what a bare value may be, the registered secrets, and (after the audit of PR #103) the PGP key, the key in one line, the exemptions (types, reads of the environment, placeholders, fetch options), the flags of a command and XML, judged by tests/verify-mask-secrets.mjs (the 49 spellings and the 47 lines of the audit, the shapes, one line for every word of a list, the edges, and the layouts for time). Second round of PR #103: the keys are hidden by hideKeyBlocks in one pass (and before the other rules), -u/--user/--proxy-user only after curl (over the continuation of a line), -p of mysql, sshpass and docker login by case. Third round of PR #103: what is hidden between two frames is what looks like a key (hideKeyText, looksLikeKey), and -u/--user/--proxy-user are masked in every command but for a numeric pair and the flags of a container client (afterContainerClient).
